name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
blurb: Remote South Atlantic islands: Napoleon's place of exile, turtle beaches and the world's most isolated settlement.
cities: Saint Helena's capital in a steep valley, with Jacob's Ladder and Napoleon's Longwood House nearby.
Volcanic cinder cones, green turtle nesting beaches and the cloud forest of Green Mountain.
The world's most remote inhabited island, reached only by a week-long sea voyage.
Remote South Atlantic islands of seabirds.
